about: The Product Scout kit is maintained in violin. `same` files are copied byte for byte: don't edit them here; change them in violin, copy them back and update `commit`. `adapted` files are workout's own versions of violin's; when violin changes one, port what applies by hand and update `commit`. brief.md, sources.md and decisions.md are workout's own. node scout/drift.js compares. See docs/decisions/0022-scout-kit.md.
